payload.statement_nl: Let $n$ be an integer greater than 1. For which real numbers $x$ is \\[\\lfloor nx \\rfloor - \\sum_{k=1}^{n} \\frac{\\lfloor kx \\rfloor}{k}\\] maximal, and what is the maximal value that this expression can take?

ambiguities: Whether the problem expects a description for all n greater than 1 as a formula in terms of n, or a separate answer for each particular n.
Whether 'maximal' means global maximum (largest value) or could be interpreted as supremum; the statement asks for the maximal value, suggesting global maximum.
Whether the answer should specify all maximizers x (possibly a set) or only one maximizer.
implicit_assumptions_surfaced: The expression f(x) is bounded above over all real x (so a maximum value exists, not just a supremum).
The maximum is attained by at least one real x (so there exists a maximizer rather than only approaching the supremum).
The question intends global maximality over all real numbers x, not maximality over a restricted interval.

domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n greater than 1
k ranges over integers with 1 less than or equal to k and k less than or equal to n
the floor function is applied to real numbers (so it is always defined)
semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: Fix an integer n greater than 1. Define f(x) = floor of n times x minus the sum from k = 1 to n of (floor of k times x) divided by k. Determine the set of real numbers x for which f(x) is a global maximum among all real y, and determine the value of that global maximum.
quantifier_order: for a given integer n greater than 1
find real x such that for all real y, expression at x is at least the expression at y
and there exists at least one real x achieving that maximal value

variables.name: n
variables.role: fixed parameter for the maximization problem; assumes n is greater than 1

variables.name: x
variables.role: optimization variable over which the expression is maximized

variables.name: k
variables.role: summation index in the expression, ranging from 1 to n

witness_dependencies: the maximizer x (if it exists) may depend on the fixed parameter n
the maximal value may depend on the fixed parameter n
